findings.finding: Actual component/interface design, fixtures, independent review, accountable owner, estimates/target agreement and applicable runtime AI/data authority remain open source-specific gates. Generic artifact plans are not final contracts or coding/sprint acceptance.

Seven augmented plan assertion groups need explicit original Then vs existing supplementary plan oracle labels in the integrated criterion/native story presentation. Task matrix already supplies the distinction; do not alter either source.

Keep37 missing source phases and13 non-qualification verification-duty proposals in the handover/decision ledger with precise resume evidence. User best-recommendation authority permits the draft proposal, not fake owner/team acceptance.

One idempotent named append per actual canonical issue after current native readback; preserve human text, parent/milestone/status/estimate/assignee and all predecessor relations. Related links remain nonblocking.

Overall AI product use and personal/organisation-sensitive data have source-backed obligations. Per-slice exclusions require actual pinned rationale; absent keywords do not establish no-use. Keep evaluation rights/configuration/critical slices/fallback and current-authority/privacy controls planned, not observed.

conclusion: No introduced source acceptance weakening identified in the29 sampled stories. Structurally consistent append proposals are suitable for reconciliation as explicitly proposed/unrun documentation. Canonical planning completion, native publication, Ready/Done, delivery and product acceptance are not established by this independent review.
